name: Pierre Pimpie - § 13 - Am 5
title: REPORT on the implementation of the VAT reverse-charge mechanism
part_text: 13.Considers that a more significant extension than those granted so far, such as the four years remaining until the deadline for the implementation of the ViDA package, should be subject to regular review, be justified by demonstrated fraud risks and be accompanied by a Commission evaluation, to ensure the measure remains relevant and to ensure continuity for businesses and tax administrations until ViDA produces its full effect; recalls that such an extension could reduce fraud structurally, simplify compliance for legitimate businesses and secure stable revenues for public services;
